title: C6 API
description: The /api/v1 shapes (system brief §11). Each route names its request and response under $defs; validate a body against `#/$defs/<name>`.

ActionIntent.description: C1: what an actor proposes in a round; a rejected or malformed one becomes `no_action`.
ActionIntent.title: ActionIntent

Amount.description: A strictly positive amount: what an intent, a leg or an obligation moves.
Amount.title: Amount

ApprovalLeg.description: One provider operation the approval binds; `after` names earlier legs it waits for.
ApprovalLeg.title: ApprovalLeg

ApprovalRequest.description: POST /api/v1/approvals: the selected policy decides again on the observed snapshot.
ApprovalRequest.title: ApprovalRequest

BoundApproval.description: C3: the operator's approval of one plan; any term outside it invalidates the whole.
BoundApproval.title: BoundApproval

Buckets.description: An account's buckets; `settled` is null exactly when the account is unknown.
Buckets.title: Buckets

Capacity.description:
K_p, the parts it is computed from, and the pool's cash accounts it could not count, all
read at one moment: authority is full exactly when nothing is unobserved.
Capacity.title: Capacity

ClearedAction.description: C2: the coordinator's verdict on one intent; the actor sees it the next round.
ClearedAction.title: ClearedAction

Coverage.description: Minimum projected cash P over the horizon against the reserve floor.
Coverage.title: Coverage

DecisionsResponse.description: GET /api/v1/decisions/{run_id}; a selection is never an approval.
DecisionsResponse.title: DecisionsResponse

DemoContext.description: The prepared demonstration run and its execution; null is unavailable, never a guess.
DemoContext.title: DemoContext

Escalation.description: When every policy fails: the earliest unmet constraint, the binding one, whom to call.
Escalation.title: Escalation

ExecutionAccepted.description: 202 from POST /api/v1/executions; the execution id is the approval id.
ExecutionAccepted.title: ExecutionAccepted

ExecutionLeg.description: A C4 leg with the label the connector's leg plan gives it.
ExecutionLeg.title: ExecutionLeg

Flow.description: An expected movement not yet settled: pending_in by `expected_at`, pending_out by due.
Flow.title: Flow

ForkRequest.description: POST /api/v1/runs/{id}/fork: one fresh branch per policy at a committed round.
ForkRequest.title: ForkRequest

IntentParams.description: An intent's arguments: `amount` is Money; any other argument is JSON with no float.
IntentParams.title: IntentParams

InterviewRequest.description: POST /api/v1/interview: read-only, still behind the demo token.
InterviewRequest.title: InterviewRequest

Metric.description: One figure on screen: a value only when known or stale; unknown is never zero.
Metric.title: Metric

Money.description: An amount in integer minor units of an ISO-4217 currency; signed inside the ledger.
Money.title: Money

NonNegativeMoney.description: An amount that is zero or more: a reserved or pledged bucket, a floor, a fee.
NonNegativeMoney.title: NonNegativeMoney

Obligation.description: A payment owed by a deadline; it is never removed by inaction.
Obligation.title: Obligation

PolicyResult.description: One policy on one scenario, read from its branch's realised ledger.
PolicyResult.title: PolicyResult

Receipt.description: What the provider's `GET` showed for a leg; `amount` is the provider's decimal string.
Receipt.title: Receipt

ReportFigure.description: A number in a report, with the structured result it came from.
ReportFigure.title: ReportFigure

RoundView.description: One committed round of one branch.
RoundView.title: RoundView

TreasuryAccount.description:
A C5 account with S (spendable now) and P (projected cash) as separate measures.

An unknown account has reduced authority and no known spendable value.
TreasuryAccount.title: TreasuryAccount

WebhookAck.description: POST /api/v1/webhooks/airwallex: a verified hint that triggers a GET.
WebhookAck.title: WebhookAck
